summary: Brief vs fixture, carried over from 1_7 (second half): brief F4 says preview 'six destructive commands'; the fixture previews five (purge, artifacts move, migrate, ledger compact, tier age) and the CHANGELOG says 'the five destructive commands' without saying why migrate --revert is out (it has nothing to preview before a migrate commit; ledger_revert.rs covers it). Say so in the entry, or amend the brief to five.
